checks: Browser first-frame HTTP503: waiting text and hidden image, automatic recovery
Continuous 30s real FILE_TEST: decoded pixels changed, at least two loop boundaries, one MJPEG connection in flight
Repeated identical frame sequence adds zero preview new frames; fresh frames recover
Browser image request failure: explicit message, broken image hidden, automatic recovery

requests.scope: 30-second continuous playback only; excludes forced reload/error fixtures

measurement_method: Preview: browser decoded unique sequences over browser monotonic interval. Processing: count delta over the two server status monotonic timestamps (status is sampled at 1Hz).
